caption: The drawing presents three views of a decorative wrought iron object with a circular, symmetrical design. At the top, there is a flat, plan view of the object rendered in gray pencil, displaying interlacing loops and curls forming a geometric pattern, with four evenly spaced rounded protrusions at the perimeter. Below this, there is a small linear scale in inches and a simple profile (side elevation) sketch, showing the object is slightly elevated from its base. Dominating the lower half of the page is an isometric view drawn with a greater degree of shading, showing the same looping, lattice structure with the four rounded feet visibly elevating it from the surface. The object appears three-dimensional, with broad, rounded bands outlining the decorative motifs. The background of the drawing is a light beige, and the entire composition is surrounded by a single-line rectangular border. At the bottom left, the name "Filippo Conca" is handwritten. The drawing uses shades of gray and black for the object, with slight yellowing and rust-colored marks along the edges of the paper.
title: Trivet
